title: Cell-free RNA analysis of plasma samples collected from six astronauts in JAXA Cell-Free Epigenome (CFE) Study
mission: International Space Station (>120 days long-duration spaceflight)
assays: Plasma Cell-Free RNA Sequencing (cfRNA RNA-Seq Illumina)
CD36+ Extracellular Mitochondria (exMT) Surface Marker Profiling

protocols.duration: >120 days on ISS (pre-flight, in-flight, post-flight longitudinal sampling)
protocols.key_finding: Microgravity induces systemic extracellular mitochondria (exMT) release and mitochondrial gene dysregulation.

diagnostic_explanation: Extended microgravity (>120 days) disrupts mitochondrial homeostasis across internal organs, releasing cell-free mitochondrial RNA into bloodstream.
